acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA on Node 22 with exit code 0 explicitly captured (the build in a copy of the tree), with output tails recorded (145 tests or more; / route First Load JS 125 kB unchanged).

The working-tree diff against f8da3ab was inspected: only files named in reports 05, 10, 12 and 13 changed, components/avatar/Avatar.tsx is unchanged, no design section 9 do-not-touch file changed other than the approved clothing bake of public/avatar.glb, and new content has no em dash or machine-local path.

F1 is confirmed fixed in the browser: after drops of about 1.6 m and 4 m at walk and run, both feet stay within 0.05 m of the ground during the land state, the crouch looks natural from side, behind and three-quarter front, the fall pose looks natural while airborne, and the blends into and out of land show no pop; the new stance tests fail on the pre-fix land.glb and fall.glb in a temp copy.

F6 is confirmed fixed: during the end and side drops off the 30 degree ramp, and while dragging the camera to at least four yaws near walls and ramps, the camera is never inside or behind a level block on any rendered frame and returns to full distance after walking clear.

No regression: idle, walk, run (straight), jump and soft landing look as approved in round 2 with fresh screenshots; F1 and F2 of round 1 (45 degree ramp) remain fixed; the hero talk, gestures, head follow and three Play/Exit cycles still work with no console errors other than the missing local API key.

The clothing bake is confirmed: hero at rest and during a gesture and the game at idle, walk and run show no visible shirt dots at normal size and none beyond imperceptible single pixels at 6x zoom of collar and sleeve hems (scanline overlay hidden for zoom shots); two bake runs are byte-identical and equal to public/avatar.glb; a fresh inventory comparison of the final baked avatar against the original shows morph targets, skin joints, inverse bind matrices, animation and face geometry unchanged, with any neck-vertex moves confined below the collar.
Every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule, and the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed.
